Carried over: visa_file is unconditionally overwritten with payload value (None when omitted), wiping a previously stored visa file on re-submit.

ui_bugs.issue: Redirect to /login?suspended=1 works, but the Arabic suspended toast is never shown. Reproduced deterministically by loading /login?suspended=1 directly: [data-sonner-toast] count = 0 at 300/600/1000/2000ms and [data-sonner-toaster] is absent, while a failed login on the same page DOES render a toast. Root cause: Login's mount useEffect calls toast.error() before sonner's <Toaster> (rendered after <Routes> in App.js) has subscribed to the toast store, so the queued toast is dropped; api.js uses window.location.href (full page reload) so this is always the case. Fix: render the suspended message as inline state/banner on the Login card, or defer with setTimeout(...,0)/useEffect after Toaster mount.

At 390x844 the wallet page has 24px horizontal overflow (document.scrollWidth=414 vs innerWidth=390) — the action-button row (شحن المحفظة / تحويل P2P / سحب أرباح) and the transactions table are not wrapped in an overflow-x-auto container. All other office/admin pages are exactly 390.

rca_of_the_issue: Suspended toast: sonner's toast() dispatches to subscribers of a module-level store; <Toaster> subscribes inside its own useEffect. Because api.js performs a hard navigation (window.location.href) to /login?suspended=1, Login mounts and its useEffect (deeper in the tree, so it runs first) fires toast.error() before <Toaster> — rendered after <Routes> in App.js — has subscribed, so the toast is discarded. Verified: [data-sonner-toaster] is absent on first paint and a later user-triggered toast (failed login) renders fine.
